rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the pepper plant or black-pepper spice when no more specific form is meant.

example.english: Adding a little pepper makes this dish more fragrant.
example.traditional: 呢道菜加少少胡椒會香啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 coi3 gaa1 siu2 siu2 wu4 ziu1 wui5 hoeng1 di1

rows.note: Use this when sense 1 specifically means ground pepper powder.

example.english: Sprinkle a little pepper on it before frying the egg.
example.traditional: 煎蛋之前灑少少胡椒粉落面。
example.jyutping: zin1 daan6 zi1 cin4 saa2 siu2 siu2 wu4 ziu1 fan2 lok6 min6

rows.note: Use this for a bell pepper of any color rather than the black-pepper spice.

example.english: I bought a bell pepper to stir-fry with beef at home.
example.traditional: 我買咗隻燈籠椒，返屋企炒牛肉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zek3 dang1 lung4 ziu1 faan1 uk1 kei2 caau2 ngau4 juk6
